title: 'Situation is Dire, There is So Much Water': Locals Seek Govt's Help as Heavy Rains Lash J&K's Ramban
description: Heavy rainfall lashed Jammu and Kashmir's Rajouri district also from early Tuesday morning, prompting the district administration and Rajouri Police to issue advisories asking residents to remain alert amid apprehensions of a rise in river water levels and the risk of flash floods, landslides and waterlogging.
